names: Creator success requires matching platform marker, allowed code, fresh output and valid scripts
postprocess contents and all five subpackages are required
metadata does not invalidate a payload, but a secret in excluded metadata is rejected
modified or extra game files cannot pass a saved build fingerprint
symlinks cannot escape a package directory
ZIP roundtrip preserves unicode/spaces, refuses overwrite and detects later tampering
build input snapshot covers runtime package, assets and web shell, excluding account UI state
source-only check exempts only git-ignored artifacts, not missing docs, source or tracked artifacts
